reason: With 8 or so boys, ₹999 for the whole shop works out about the same as those ₹99-per-technician apps, and the AMC renewal reminders going out on their own is money I lose today when I forget. First month is free and I only pay if my technicians actually use it, so I lose nothing by letting him set it up.
objection: My technicians live on WhatsApp. I doubt they will press a button and talk after every job instead of just sending a photo to the group, and if they don't, I'm back to chasing them by chat anyway.
